description: The file is a PHP class definition for the Product model in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It contains methods to retrieve product details, categories, attributes, and related data from the database. The class extends the system's engine model and utilizes database queries to fetch and cache product information.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for handling product data, including retrieval of product details, categories, attributes, and search functionalities within the Opencart platform.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for handling product data, including retrieval of product details, categories, attributes, options, discounts, images, related products, and search filtering within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing statement subqueries and setting the registry.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific product by its ID, including price, ratings, reviews, and variants.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products based on provided filter and sorting parameters, with caching support.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Gets categories associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Checks if a product belongs to a specific category.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attribute groups and attributes associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getProductAttributeGroups
methods.description: Retrieves attribute groups and their associated attributes for a specific product, returning structured data about attribute group IDs, names, and individual attributes with attribute IDs, names, and descriptive texts.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches available options for a product, including option values, for a given product ID. It collects options with their IDs, names, types, values, and whether they are required.

methods.name: getDiscounts
methods.description: Retrieves all applicable discounts for a specific product, filtering by customer group, quantity, and active date range.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Gets all images related to a product, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription plan details associated with a product, filtered by product ID and subscription plan ID, considering active status and customer group.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription plans available for a product, including descriptions, ordered by their sort order.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Obtains the layout ID assigned to a product based on the store configuration; returns 0 if none assigned.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Fetches related products for a specific product, including their name, image, discount, special, reward, and review data, optimized with caching.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Counts total products matching provided filtering criteria such as category, subcategory, filter ID, search terms, manufacturer, and other filters. Supports complex filtering and joins.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Retrieves special offers for products, with optional filtering and ordering, including product description, name, image, price, and other relevant data.

methods.name: getTotalSpecials
methods.description: Calculates the total number of special-priced products, considering store and customer group filters.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Adds a report entry for a specific product with IP and country data, recording the report in the database.
